>
> If im just interested in raw copy number estimates for the Nsp chip,
> do I need to run everything over again for the Sty chip.

No, the two chip types are only combined just before fitting the
segmentation model. If you only have one chip type, that is enough.

> In addition,
> do I need to run the glad algorithm to be able to obtain raw
> estimates.
No, if you by "run" mean calling fit(). You do not have to call fit().
